candidates.name: The basis of HM Land Registry plans (practice guide 40, supplement 1)
verified_facts: Ordnance Survey mapping shows topographical features existing at survey time.
OS maps are multi-purpose and the detail is not intended to represent property boundaries.
HM Land Registry uses OS MasterMap as the basis for its plans.
semantic_limits: A topographic feature or MasterMap line cannot be treated as the legal parcel boundary without HMLR title evidence.

candidates.name: Guidance for preparing plans for HM Land Registry applications
verified_facts: The title plan and register cannot describe land more accurately than the pre-registration deeds allow.
Plans should be drawn accurately to stated scale and be orientable to the OS map.
An additional plan used to identify land is not evidence of the applicant's title.
semantic_limits: Plan drafting quality or scale alone cannot promote geometry to stronger legal-title evidence.
